rows.text: tail-jumps `003845F0` with `rcx` set to `02F973C0` plus the sign-extended `ecx` times 8

returns -1 when the word `cx` is `0xFFFF` or its top nibble field (`AND 0xF000`) is above `0xE000` unsigned; otherwise takes the record at `01EEBCC0` plus (word >> 12) times `0x58`, returns 0 when the low 12 bits exceed (signed) the record's dword `+0x3C` minus 1 or when its qword `+0x50` is null, and else tail-jumps that qword with `ecx` = the word and `edx` = 1
